content: dms-window-buttons v1.0.0 silent no-op: NiriService.send behind Quickshell.env(NIRI_SOCKET) guard — DMS env has NO NIRI_SOCKET (starts from user dinit/turnstile, not niri child); close worked (native toplevel.close). v1.0.1: niri msg action with self-resolved $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/niri*.sock; buttons = down/up move-column-to-workspace-*, maximize-column (=Mod+F), close.

KDE apps dark: KColorScheme reads ~/.config/kdeglobals [Colors:*] (ksystemlog: direct, hardcoded Breeze Light without it; okular: KColorSchemeManager looks for .colors files in XDG data dirs first, falls back to kdeglobals system scheme). Portal/QPalette path already dark (xdgdesktopportal + portal prefer-dark; Qt 6.11 fusion colorScheme-aware). Fix: installer seeds kdeglobals with self-contained BreezeDark [Colors:*]+[ColorEffects:*] (upstream BreezeDark.colors LGPL-2.0-or-later, translations dropped) + [Icons] Theme=breeze-dark. NOT via Alpine breeze pkg (only carrier; pulls qt5+kf5 ~100MB). NOTE [General] ColorScheme in kdeglobals is LEGACY; KF6 >=6.16 uses [UiSettings] ColorScheme=<id> + scheme files — we skip both, kdeglobals colors are enough.
